findings.what: The blocking coverage gate still accepts an unsigned forged ok:true completion record as proof that a role ran.
findings.why: evaluate() only requires role, ok:true, dispatch_id, cmdline_checksum, current argv_schema_version, and output_digest/artifact proof; it never calls attest-signing.verifyRecord. A hand-authored record with those fields and no attest_sig returns ok:true/covered, so the round-3 signature hardening does not cover this live liveness gate.

findings.what: The sprint coverage backing-record readers still trust unsigned ok:true dispatch-completion records.
findings.why: hasBackingDispatchRecord in both files treats role + ok:true + sprint/time correlation as sufficient and never verifies attest_sig. These are blocking scan gates for missing design/hook coverage, so a forged unsigned dispatch record can satisfy the 'backing dispatch record' requirement and hide that the required agent never ran.

parsed.summary: Round-3 targeted fixes are complete for the named surfaces: gauntlet-verify signs and verifies role/ok/provider/completed_at-or-started_at/sprint_id/fallback, applyPanelGate is live requireSignature:true, verifyTyped defaults signature verification on, and bare Alex/Greek alpha are blocked without false-positives on alexa-connector/alpha-tester/alexander. The verdict still fails because other live dispatch-liveness readers remain unsigned.
